scenarios.name: first-entry-plain-return-invreq
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the closing RETURN TRANSID .. COMMAREA RESP (A010) fails INVREQ RESP2 4 (planned: IBM's TRANSID in a program associated with an APPC logical unit, register X71) -- the program goes on to its A010 abend routine

notes: CBSA's transfer-funds screen (BNK1TFN, transaction OTFN, BMS map BNK1TF of mapset BNK1TFM: the symbolic map is generated from src/base/bms_src/BNK1TFM.bms). Pseudo-conversational: a first task sends the empty map; a returning one acts on the AID -- PA keys nothing, PF3 RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE, PF12 the termination message, CLEAR, ENTER (BIF DEEDIT of both account numbers, the same-account and zero-account checks, VALIDATE-AMOUNT, then LINK XFRFUN with SUBPGM-PARMS), any other key 'Invalid key pressed.'. XFRFUN and ABNDPROC run in the task, as in cbsa-xfrfun. ACCOUNT and PROCTRAN are compared after every scenario. Every amount typed is exact in a binary double (a COMP-2 holding 9999999999.99 is not: truncated on COBOL, rounded on Java: oracle_assumptions.md C6). The COMMAREA is compared as the program RETURNs it, WS-COMMAREA. Not reached: an amount longer than WS-AMOUNT-UNSTR's 13 characters (the program then reference-modifies 14 characters of a 13-character item: where that reads depends on storage layout, so the Java side refuses it and no scenario is written), an account number with no digit at all (BIF DEEDIT of such a field is not modelled: refused), XFRFUN's code 4 (an amount not above zero: VALIDATE-AMOUNT refuses zero and negatives first) and the failure branches after SEND MAP / SEND TEXT / SEND CONTROL / RETURN / LINK (no fault can be injected on them). Data: seed.sql is cbsa-xfrfun's SYNTHETIC seed.
